text: This report presents the results of stakeholder consultations conducted throughout this spring on the draft Inclusionary Zoning (IZ) Implementation Guidelines and provides an update on ongoing area-specific analysis. City Council adopted IZ Official Plan policies, a Zoning By-law Amendment and draft Implementation Guidelines on November 12, 2021. The Official Plan policies require between 5 and 22 per cent of new residential gross floor area to be secured as affordable rental or ownership housing for a period of 99 years. As part of City Council's adopted IZ policy framework, Council directed staff to consult and report back with final recommended Implementation Guidelines in the first half of 2022.
